name: Tiny Toads

features.name: Toad meters
features.description: Insects raise their matching toad's value.

features.name: Hit'n Roll wilds
features.description: Wilds move up or down the reels.

review:
A lakeside game with crocodiles, swans, fish and lily-pad wilds. Purple, green and red insects land on the grid, each matched to a toad above the reels with a value from zero to six – every insect feeds its toad and raises your free spins chances.

Wilds trigger Hit'n Roll, moving up or down the reels. Three scatters on reels one, three and five give nine free spins. Feeding the toads makes the base game feel like progress. 96.51% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
